source_state: uncommitted independent ordinary preparation, snapshot and copy ownership
behavior: Independent prompt and sampler preparation acquire a domain owner before allocation. Explicitly unbudgeted requests retain this requirement even when they carry a preparation handle.

Reserved preparation invokes shared workers under its one-use request authority without acquiring a conflicting unquoted lease. Prompt backing retains the existing reservation before binding and through raw lazy aliases.
Eager prompt backing carries an allocation owner before NewAxis construction. Greedy host history and stochastic samplers retain independent ownership after the backend or runtime retires.

Native state capture, sampling copies, pending-input copies and RNG reseeding acquire independent owners before allocation. Active same-domain reservations reject them without mutating sources or counters.

Copied prompt/token/RNG backing carries its own owner. Native snapshot payloads remain encapsulated; state exchange moves guards with installed and displaced state only after atomic semantic exchange succeeds.
Sampling submissions retain memory authorities before native work and recovery. Restore merges current and incoming sampler authorities without duplicate leases or request refunds.
Empty pending input and temperature-only overrides acquire no new owner. Snapshot estimates include ownership metadata without native allocation.
Controlled native continuation, RNG/adaptation, convolution/recurrent state, intervention/capture, recovery and ordinary/controlled preparation regressions pass alongside focused lifetime tests.
limits: Public strict managed budgets still reject UnknownBound. Conservative unquoted exclusion is not successful quoted-copy admission or checked model/state promotion.
The new isolated-pool tests deliberately separate model and preparation domains to observe independent-operation lifetime and rejection. They do not certify a complete public native peak quote.

Speculative preparation and copies, lazy observer escapes, exact nonempty decoder-state overlap, rank-coordinated admission and complete paging/materialization/media/capture bounds remain outstanding.
No native wrapper changes or new released-checkpoint numerics/peak measurements were needed for this ownership increment; earlier numerical and native identity records remain separate.
The feature check retains existing unused-helper warnings. Native test linking reports the existing large unwind-table warning.
corrected_validation_findings: Initial compilation required an explicit error-source reference lifetime and cloning a retained owner before mutating a dereferenced retirement payload.

The first native run passed 69 tests and found one new test assumed NewAxis storage was already certified. The corrected test verifies protection with only a raw lazy alias surviving, then evaluates it; production preparation remains lazy.

Review found admitted prompt arrays could escape before binding and that Some(preparation) can be explicitly unbudgeted. Reserved backing attachment and guarded unbudgeted branches now have dedicated regressions.
